worldcombat.skill.ember.summary: Flicks out a small, quick spark that arcs onto the target; it shatters into a few embers and may set the target alight. Fast to fire and quick to recover - the steadiest little fire when nothing else is ready.
worldcombat.skill.ember.use.0: Finish with a quick tossed spark
worldcombat.skill.ember.use.2: A small fire when you cannot spread one
worldcombat.skill.ember.description.0: The spark flies at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block radius, dealing %1$s special damage on a hit.
worldcombat.skill.ember.description.1: Range: %1$s blocks. Has a %2$s chance to burn the target.
worldcombat.skill.ember.charged.on: Charged: power x1.4, ignition +5%%, a bigger spark, but +4 ticks wind-up, +8 cooldown and -1 block range.
worldcombat.skill.ember.charged.off: Rapid: faster to fire, farther and quicker to recover, at the cost of power and ignition.
worldcombat.skill.ember.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.ember.growth.0: From level %1$s the spark rises to %2$s power and %3$s embers.
worldcombat.skill.ember.growth.1: From level %1$s the spark rises to %2$s power and %3$s ignition chance.
worldcombat.skill.ember.preference.charg: On: power x1.4, ignition +5%%, a bigger spark, but +4 ticks wind-up, +8 cooldown and -1 block range. Off (rapid): faster to fire, farther and quicker to recover, at the cost of power and ignition.
worldcombat.skill.ember.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.ember.preference.ai.fi: On: low-health targets rank first, finished with this cheap spark; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
